datasets.description: This pseudo dataset contains 20 generated blue-laser degradation trajectories based on 19 original life-test records at 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, and 4.5 A. The source tests used a 25 °C water-cooling setpoint. Each trajectory covers 0–500 h at 0.5 h intervals, with optical power, current, voltage, wavelength, and bandwidth. Low-output spectral fluctuations follow the patterns in the original instrument records.
datasets.coverage: One CSV per pseudo device. Trajectories cover 0–500 h; records that do not reach the chosen failure threshold by 500 h are right censored. Use the 20 h optical-power value as the reference for normalized-power analyses. Large wavelength and bandwidth fluctuations at very low optical output represent instrument-like tail readings.
